messages.body:
PR #113 was labelled review-rejected on GitHub.

kigster (https://github.com/kigster/openlanes/pull/113#issuecomment-6332819713):

Review round 1: rejected (1/2).

**1. `Vcs::GitHub#branch_checks` reads check runs only, so CI on `main` is never seen on this repo** (`lib/openlanes/vcs/github.rb`, `branch_checks`; used by `Merging#main_ci`)
- Input: `main` as it is now. CI here is CircleCI, which reports commit statuses (`StatusContext`, e.g. `ci/circleci: test`), not check runs.
- Expected: `main_ci` is `:green`, since `repos/kigster/openlanes/commits/main/status` shows linter, web, test and e2e all `success`, so a passing, verified PR merges.
- Actual: `gh api repos/kigster/openlanes/commits/main/check-runs` returns `[]`. `CiGate.verdict([])` is `:none`, so `merge` returns "waits on CI on main, which is none" on every poll and nothing ever merges. The reverse also holds: a red CircleCI status on `main` is invisible once any green check run exists, so a broken `main` would not hold a merge.
- Fix: also read `commits/<branch>/status` (or `commits/<branch>/check-runs` plus `/status`), map `state` success/failure/error/pending to buckets, and combine both lists.

**2. No test for `branch_checks`/`bucket_of`**
- `github_spec.rb` has no example for it, and the fake `gh` serves only `check-runs`. A status-only `main` (finding 1) therefore cannot fail any test. Add a status-only `main` example that expects `:green`, and a red-status one that expects the merge held.

entries.text: Most of R5 already existed in Engine::Merging (palpatine verdicts, ready-to-merge, PR CI, BEHIND, sibling rebase). This round added only what was missing.
The passing-verdict condition is implicit: ready-to-merge replaces review-approved/ok-not-perfect, and only chewie applies it after a passing review
Main CI comes from gh api commits/main/check-runs, mapped to gh pr checks buckets. Red, pending or none waits; it never leaves the PR for a person
DIRTY merge state leaves the PR merge-manually with a comment; UNKNOWN waits
Other plans' checkouts are queued at merge time and rebased by Dispatcher#settle_merges via rebase_queued(busy: untouchable). Push only when the plan has an open PR
U1 gates and U2 rebase queue built with specs; rspec 4168/0 failures, rubocop clean; signed Completed round 1
Boundary is covered only indirectly: the rebase never runs while the checkout is busy. No end-to-end Boundary spec yet
Review finding 1 fixed: Vcs::GitHub#branch_checks reads commits/<branch>/check-runs and commits/<branch>/status together; status_bucket maps success→pass, pending→pending, else fail
Review finding 2 fixed: github_spec #branch_checks (4 examples) and merging_spec status-only main merges, red status beside green run holds; fake gh serves commits/<ref>/status from main_statuses
PR #113 has no inline review comments; findings came in top-level comment 6332819713. Writing pull-requests.md was refused: the plan folder lock belongs to the harness (openlanes@...:51493)
rspec 4174 examples, 0 failures, 9 pending (web/dist missing, pre-existing); rubocop 0 offenses; signed Completed --next hansolo-reviewer
